description: This file contains shell script functions for managing U-Boot environment configurations in OpenWrt, including adding configurations to UCI, handling different storage mediums (like MTD, MMC, UBI), and setting default UBI environments.

methods.name: _ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Adds a U-Boot environment configuration to UCI with specified parameters.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Wrapper function to add U-Boot environment configuration of type 'ubootenv'.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_sys_config
methods.description: Wrapper function to add U-Boot system environment configuration of type 'ubootsys'.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_app_config
methods.description: Adds an application-specific U-Boot environment configuration based on the configuration file.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_mtd
methods.description: Adds U-Boot environment configuration from an MTD device.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_sys_mtd
methods.description: Adds U-Boot system environment configuration from an MTD device.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_mmc
methods.description: Adds U-Boot environment configuration from an MMC partition.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_ubi_default
methods.description: Sets up default UBI environment configurations using nand.sh scripts.
